{{short description|Slovak mathematician}}
'''Milan Kolibiar''' (born 14 February 1922 in [[Detvianska Huta]], died 9 July 1994 in [[Bratislava]]) was a [[Slovakia|Slovak]] mathematician.

He worked mostly in [[lattice theory]] and [[universal algebra]].
